description: Connecticut business entities (Secretary of the State, via Open Data CT) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md and the review record in docs/registry/sources/ct-sos-entities.md.

sources.publisher: Connecticut Secretary of the State, Business Services Division (via Open Data CT, data.ct.gov)
sources.license: Public Domain: the dataset's portal metadata states license 'Public Domain' (licenseId PUBLIC_DOMAIN). The portal's Terms of Use add disclaimers (data provided 'as is', no warranty, the State may discontinue content at any time) and no restriction on use
sources.redistribution: Permitted (public domain); attribution given anyway: Connecticut Secretary of the State
sources.notes: Dataset n7gp-d28j 'Connecticut Business Registry - Business Master': 1,305,856 rows on 2026-11-03 (464,123 Active; the rest Forfeited, Dissolved, Withdrawn, Revoked, Cancelled, Merged and others), updated daily. The file is a filtered SODA CSV of 17 of 57 columns (name, type, status, accountnumber, business address, citizenship and state of formation, dates, mailing address); the business email address and the Salesforce id are not selected. About 209 bytes a row, so roughly 270 MB in all: over the 50 MB limit for a local run, so the full load runs from GitHub's network (a 20,000-row sample is 4.2 MB). Businesses of type 'Unauthorized' carry the placeholder account number 0000000. Principals (ka36-64k6) and agents (qh2m-n44y) are separate datasets, mostly natural persons, and are not collected. robots.txt: Crawl-delay 1; /browse search pages disallowed, /resource/ and /api/ allowed. The portal platform's own terms (socrata.com) still need a human read (same note as ny-dos-entities and co-sos-entities).
